announcements.headline: Notice of Trading Update
announcements.insight: Greggs issues a trading update following its CFO retirement and interim results notice. Shareholders should watch for operational performance details in the forthcoming results.

announcements.headline: Notice of Interim Results
announcements.insight: Greggs issues an interim results notice. This follows recent governance changes, including a CFO retirement in July.

announcements.headline: CFO Retirement and Succession
announcements.insight: Greggs announces CFO retirement. This follows recent director appointments and shareholding amendments in May and June 2026.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director/PDMR Shareholding details are reported. This follows an earlier Amendment in May and a Non-Executive Director appointment in June.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Non-Executive Director
announcements.insight: Greggs appoints a new Non-Executive Director. This follows an earlier amendment to director shareholdings in May 2026.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding - Amendment
announcements.insight: Greggs has filed a director dealing update. Shareholders should monitor future filings for significant changes in insider shareholdings.
